common.loadingEvidence: Loading the evidence behind this result
common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong while loading this section.

status.confidenceNote: Confidence describes the quality of the underlying data only. It is not a measure of religious certainty.
status.appendOnly: Screening runs are append-only. This record is never edited.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Every status below is one methodology's output, on a recorded data snapshot, with its evidence available.
dashboard.emptyBody: This build ships with a fabricated demonstration dataset: four securities across two markets, two example methodologies, and one deliberately unknown disclosure. Nothing in it describes a real issuer.
dashboard.noRunsBody: Open a security to run a methodology against its latest reported period.
dashboard.reviewQueueBody: Nothing on your watchlist is waiting on a decision.
dashboard.addToWatchlist: Add a security to your watchlist

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search by ticker, company name or identifier. Results show the methodology each status was produced under.
search.noMatchesBody: Try a ticker such as NWT, or part of a company name.

stock.unknownEffect: Effect: this reduces confidence and may cause a review state.
stock.livePriceNote: A current quote is shown separately for context. It is not part of the screening, and the screen is not refreshed when a price changes.
stock.noRunYet: No screening run recorded for this methodology yet.
stock.noRunYetBody: Run the methodology to produce a sealed result with its evidence.
stock.structuredEvidenceOnly: AI text discarded — showing structured evidence only
stock.structuredEvidenceOnlyBody: The generated text did not pass validation against the engine's evidence, so it was discarded. Every figure below comes straight from the engine.
stock.validationPassed: Every figure in this text was checked against the engine's evidence.
stock.noMarginDefined: No borderline margin is defined by this methodology version for this criterion.
stock.decidedCategorically: Decided from the reported segment disclosure — no numeric threshold applies
stock.noPriorRuns: No earlier run for this methodology.

why.title: Why this assessment
why.noUnknowns: No unknown inputs were recorded for this run.
why.noUnknownsBody: Every input this methodology requires was available and resolvable.
why.engineDecides: The state above was produced by the deterministic engine. A language model never changes it.

compare.title: Compare methodologies
compare.subtitle: The same security, the same reporting period, evaluated independently under each methodology. Disagreement is a difference between documented rules and treatments, not an error.
compare.noWinner: Neither methodology is declared correct here. They document different rules, and the difference is reported without a preference.
compare.causeUnknown: The difference follows from an input that one methodology requires and the other does not
compare.sameResult: Both methodologies produced the same result for this criterion.

methodologies.title: Methodology Center
methodologies.subtitle: Every rule this application applies, with its source reference, version and verification status.
methodologies.noChangeHistory: No recorded changes since this version became effective.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Securities you follow, each with the methodology its recorded status was produced under.
watchlist.emptyBody: Create a list, then add securities from search or from a stock page.
watchlist.noItems: This list has no securities yet.
watchlist.noChanges: No changes since the last check

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Every alert states the reason it was raised, naming the criterion, the methodology and the figures involved.
alerts.emptyBody: Alerts appear when a recorded status changes, a criterion crosses a threshold, a methodology version changes, or a new filing arrives.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Display preferences and the language the application's own wording is drawn from.
settings.languageNote: The interface ships in English. All interface wording is held in a translation file, and the layout uses logical directions, so an Arabic right-to-left interface can be enabled later without changes to the screens.
settings.shariahTermsNote: Terms are taken from a glossary and are never machine-translated. Each entry records the term as it is used and a plain description of what it means on this platform.
settings.defaultMethodologyNote: Screens open under this methodology version unless you choose another.
settings.providerNote: The adapter currently supplying every figure in this application.
settings.numberFormatNote: Figures are formatted for the interface language and the currency each security reports in.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Methodology definitions, data and the audit trail.
admin.productionBlocked: Production cannot be enabled until the source URL, the verifier and the verification date are all filled in.
admin.productionBlockedShort: Missing source URL, verifier or verification date
admin.label: Label
admin.numeratorItemsHint: Comma separated line item keys, for example: cash_and_equivalents, interest_bearing_investments
admin.denominatorItemsHint: Comma separated line item keys, for example: total_assets
admin.borderlineMarginHint: Leave empty when the methodology defines no borderline margin. An empty margin is never replaced with an assumed default.
admin.immutableNotice: A methodology version is immutable once created. Changing a rule means creating a new version, so past runs keep pointing at the rules they were produced under.
admin.demoNote: Writes the fabricated dataset through the provider adapters: exchanges, companies, securities, periods, facts, segments, sources, methodologies, versions and criteria. Existing demonstration records are updated in place rather than duplicated.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Terms used on this platform, with a plain description of what each one means here.

disclaimer.short: Informational screening only — not a fatwa. Methodologies and scholarly interpretations differ. Financial analysis is not personalized investment advice.
disclaimer.full: This application provides informational stock analysis and Shariah screening based on selected, documented methodologies and publicly available information. It is not a fatwa, does not constitute an individualized religious ruling, and does not represent itself as a Shariah authority. Different scholars, institutions, and methodologies may reach different conclusions. Financial data and screening results can change as new disclosures and methodology updates become available. Users seeking religious guidance for their personal circumstances should consult a qualified Shariah scholar or advisory body. Investment-related analysis is informational and is not personalized investment advice. Investing involves risk, including loss of capital.

methodology.pageNote: This page documents how the application implements this methodology. It does not constitute endorsement or a religious ruling.

banner.exampleMethodology: EXAMPLE — not verified — not production. This methodology is a demonstration definition. It is not a published standard and carries no endorsement.
banner.demo: SYNTHETIC / DEMO. Every figure, filing, price and methodology on this screen is fabricated for demonstration. No real issuer, market or ruling is described.
